HTTP2::disconnect
Description
This command allows you to cleanly terminate the current HTTP/2
session. Cleanly terminates the current HTTP/2 session, if HTTP/2 is
active.
Syntax
HTTP2
::
disconnect
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{[
HTTP2
::
active
]}
{
HTTP2
::
disconnect
}
}
